description: This file defines TypeScript types, interfaces, and external references for Playwright's internal structures, including page, frame, browser, and element handling, as well as external modules like 'child_process', 'stream', and 'fs'. It also includes licensing information and exports for Electron and Android related types.

classes.name: TimeoutError
classes.description: Custom error class for timeout-related errors.

classes.name: Accessibility
classes.description: Interface for accessibility snapshot and nodes.

classes.name: ElectronApplication
classes.description: Interface for evaluating scripts within Electron applications.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a function in the context of the page, frame, or Electron app.

methods.name: evaluateHandle
methods.description: Evaluates a function and returns a handle to the result.

methods.name: addInitScript
methods.description: Adds a script to be evaluated in the context of the page or frame.

methods.name: removeAllListeners
methods.description: Removes all event listeners of a specified type.

methods.name: connectOverCDP
methods.description: Connects to a browser over Chrome DevTools Protocol.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a command to the CDP session.
